text:
zoe: alert — SCIM deprovision failures spiked ~14% at 13:12 UTC, lots of 403s and orphaned service accounts in the audit. Anyone rotate service principals recently?
liam: I merged a TF change at 13:05 that renamed the SCIM role: arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/scim-rotate -> arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/scim-rotate-v2
catalina: that'll cause KMS denies if the key policy wasn't updated. can you paste the provisioner error?
liam: log excerpt:
```
2026-05-02T13:11:58Z ERROR scim-provisioner decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444555666777:key/9a8b7c6d
```
zoe: yep — KMS AccessDenied. Key policy missing new principal; decrypts fail -> items get retried and become orphaned.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-5021 "SCIM deprov KMS AccessDenied after principal rename" — paging eng-platform
liam: applying key policy update now; will keep old role ARN for 24h grace. snippet to append: {"Sid":"AllowScim","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/scim-rotate","arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/scim-rotate-v2"]},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}
catalina: after policy change restart scim-provisioner to flush cached KMS contexts: kubectl rollout restart deployment/scim-provisioner -n idp
kms-bot: key policy updated (kp-993) at 2026-05-02T13:18:12Z
liam: restarted, seeing decrypts succeed and deprovisions complete: "decrypt succeeded" / "deprovisioned svcacc-91"
zoe: running backfill for 13:00–13:18 window, will check audit logs for correlation-id gaps. follow-ups: update RBAC-rename runbook to include KMS key policy step, add CI lint to flag ARN changes vs key policies, improve correlation ids in KMS+SCIM logs.
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-5021 resolved — root cause: principal rename not added to KMS key policy; remediation: updated policy, restarted provisioner, ran backfill.
